messages:
maya: Quick UX check — in the console help overlay we use "model version" in some places and "model variant" in others. It keeps coming up in demos as confusing. Can we pick a canonical term? (cc @liam @cheng)

liam: +1. Product copy uses "version" for rollout/pinning, "variant" for quantization/precision in runtime. Users won't know the distinction without an explanation.

cheng: Proposal: use "model version" as the primary user-facing term everywhere (headings, breadcrumbs). Use "variant" only inline where we mean runtime config (e.g., "v1 (int8 variant)") and add a tooltip explaining it.

olivia: Accessibility note — if we do tooltips, ensure they are exposed to screen readers (role="tooltip" + aria-describedby). Also the help overlay's close control currently isn't announced.

maya: Also noticed the overlay "Learn more" CTA opens docs in a new tab. Design prefers the in-panel docs sidecar for continuity. Thoughts on which CTA text we should use?

liam: In-panel sidecar is better for discoverability, but we have a keyboard trap: focus doesn't reliably return to the originating form after closing the sidecar. We should fix that before switching most links.

cheng: Accessibility nit: close button should be explicit: 
```html
<button aria-label="Close documentation" data-testid="help-close">✕</button>
```
Ensure ESC closes and focus returns to the last interactive element.

olivia: Copy suggestion: change CTA from "Learn more" to "Open docs" for in-app sidecar, keep "Learn more" for external links. That gives a clearer affordance. :thumbsup:

maya: UI ask: add a prominent crosslink at the top of the overlay to "Routing policies → model fallback" — lots of support tickets indicate users can't find the fallback doc.

liam: Also request: map search aliases so typing "reserved" or "reserved capacity" returns the "Dedicated" docs page. Customers keep using different terms. We already have some redirect rules but need a small alias table in the help index.

cheng: Backend doable — I'll add a help-aliases.json mapping and wire it into search. Will need a short docs PR to list accepted synonyms.

maya: I'll draft the microcopy for headings/tooltips and the crosslink text in Figma. Will post a screenshot here.

olivia: I can do an a11y checklist for the sidecar keyboard flow and pair with @cheng tomorrow for testing.

liam: Once fixed, let's include a tiny release note: "Help overlay: unified naming (model version), in-app docs sidecar, improved keyboard navigation, and search alias support."

doc-bot: Reference: existing docs draft on naming: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/help/variants-vs-versions — compare and we can merge microcopy changes.

maya: Great — action items: 1) cheng add alias mapping PR, 2) olivia a11y checklist + test plan, 3) maya copy + figma mock, 4) liam dev QA on focus restore. I'll collect tomorrow's sync notes and update the project card. :white_check_mark:
